name: @iflow-mcp/calebl-ynab-mcp-server

tools.name: ynab_list_budgets
tools.description: Lists all available budgets from YNAB API

tools.name: ynab_get_unapproved_transactions
tools.description: Gets unapproved transactions from a budget. First time pulls last 3 days, subsequent pulls use server knowledge to get only changes.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget to fetch transactions for (optional, defaults to the budget set in the YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

tools.name: ynab_budget_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the budget for a specific month highlighting overspent categories that need attention and categories with a positive balance that are doing well.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget to get a summary for (optional, defaults to the budget set in the YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

month.description: The budget month in ISO format (e.g. 2016-12-01). The string 'current' can also be used to specify the current calendar month (UTC)

tools.name: ynab_create_transaction
tools.description: Creates a new transaction in your YNAB budget. Either payeeId or payeeName must be provided in addition to the other required fields.

budgetId.description: The id of the budget to create the transaction in (optional, defaults to the budget set in the YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

accountId.description: The id of the account to create the transaction in

date.description: The date of the transaction in ISO format (e.g. 2024-03-24)

payeeId.description: The id of the payee (optional if payeeName is provided)

payeeName.description: The name of the payee (optional if payeeId is provided)

categoryId.description: The category id for the transaction (optional)

cleared.description: Whether the transaction is cleared (optional, defaults to false)

approved.description: Whether the transaction is approved (optional, defaults to false)

flagColor.description: The transaction flag color (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) (optional)

tools.name: ynab_approve_transaction
tools.description: Approves an existing transaction in your YNAB budget.

budgetId.description: The id of the budget containing the transaction (optional, defaults to the budget set in the YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

transactionId.description: The id of the transaction to approve

approved.description: Whether the transaction should be marked as approved

tools.name: ynab_update_category_budget
tools.description: Updates the budgeted amount for a category in a specific month. Use this to allocate funds to categories or move money between categories.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

month.description: The budget month in ISO format (e.g. 2024-01-01). Must be the first day of the month.

categoryId.description: The ID of the category to update

budgeted.description: The amount to budget in dollars (e.g. 500.00). This sets the total budgeted amount, not an increment.

tools.name: ynab_update_transaction
tools.description: Updates an existing transaction. All fields except transactionId are optional - only provide fields you want to change.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

transactionId.description: The ID of the transaction to update

accountId.description: Move transaction to a different account

date.description: The date of the transaction in ISO format (e.g. 2024-03-24)

amount.description: The amount in dollars (e.g. -10.99 for outflow, 10.99 for inflow)

payeeName.description: The name of the payee (creates new payee if doesn't exist)

categoryId.description: The category ID for the transaction

tools.name: ynab_bulk_approve_transactions
tools.description: Approves multiple transactions at once. Provide an array of transaction IDs to approve them all in a single API call.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

transactionIds.description: Array of transaction IDs to approve

tools.name: ynab_list_payees
tools.description: Lists all payees in a budget. Useful for finding payee IDs when creating transactions.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

tools.name: ynab_get_transactions
tools.description: Gets transactions from a budget with optional filters. Can filter by date range, account, category, payee, or approval status.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

sinceDate.description: Only return transactions on or after this date (ISO format: 2024-01-01)

type.description: Filter by transaction type. Defaults to 'all'.

accountId.description: Filter to only transactions in this account

categoryId.description: Filter to only transactions in this category

payeeId.description: Filter to only transactions with this payee

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default: 100)

tools.name: ynab_delete_transaction
tools.description: Deletes a transaction from the budget. This action cannot be undone.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

transactionId.description: The ID of the transaction to delete

tools.name: ynab_list_categories
tools.description: Lists all categories in a budget, grouped by category group. Useful for finding category IDs when creating transactions or updating budgets.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

tools.name: ynab_list_accounts
tools.description: Lists all accounts in a budget. Useful for finding account IDs when creating transactions.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

includeClosedAccounts.description: Include closed accounts in the list (default: false)

tools.name: ynab_list_scheduled_transactions
tools.description: Lists all scheduled (recurring) transactions in a budget.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

tools.name: ynab_import_transactions
tools.description: Imports available transactions on all linked accounts for the budget. This triggers an import from connected financial institutions (equivalent to clicking 'Import' in the YNAB app).

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)

tools.name: ynab_list_months
tools.description: Lists all budget months. Each month contains summary information about budgeting status.

budgetId.description: The ID of the budget (optional, defaults to YNAB_BUDGET_ID environment variable)
